item.title: U-Haul report: Alabama ninth-highest level of in-migration; Auburn 17th-ranked U.S. growth city
item.description: U-Haul released its annual growth index on Monday morning, showing the states that experienced the most in-migration in 2025, and Alabama ranked ninth.According to the moving company, the high growth rate could be due to political factors. In a press release, U-Haul said that seven of the top 10 growth states currently feature Republican governors, while nine of those states went red in the last presidential election.
